resources.string: Find nearby people when service is down.
Turn these on to find nearby people.
Find devices and share your location.
Turn them on, then check again.
Android may also ask for notifications or microphone access.
Works without cellular service or internet.
ResQMesh helps nearby phones exchange messages over Bluetooth, without mobile data or internet.
Another phone can relay a message when a usable mesh path exists. Range and delivery are not guaranteed.
Check connection status on Home. Send text in Messages, or share recorded voice notes in Radio.
To find nearby ResQMesh phones, choose your name and allow the requested access during setup.
Open the red SOS action, choose the emergency type, then slide to broadcast your alert.
Sending does not confirm receipt. Contact emergency services whenever they are available.
